# Spectecle

> Spectecle is a web design, SEO, and AI automation studio based in Dearborn, Michigan, serving Metro Detroit and clients nationwide. The same small team designs, builds, and ranks each site. The legal entity is Spectecle LLC.

- Service area: Dearborn, Dearborn Heights, Detroit, and Metro Detroit; remote clients across the United States
- Phone: (313) 353-4105
- Email: hello@spectecle.com
- Hours: every day, 9 AM to 9 PM (Eastern)
- Google Business Profile: https://maps.google.com/?cid=16659534901346479284

## Services

- [Services overview](https://spectecle.com/services): web design and development, SEO, ad campaigns, and AI automation
- [Web design in Detroit](https://spectecle.com/services/web-design-detroit): custom, fast-loading websites built to rank and convert
- [SEO agency in Detroit](https://spectecle.com/services/seo-agency-detroit): technical SEO, keyword strategy, content, and local SEO
- [AI and workflow automation](https://spectecle.com/services/ai-automation): AI intake agents and automated workflows connected to CRMs and team tools
- [Law firm website design](https://spectecle.com/services/law-firm-website-design): websites for attorneys and legal practices
- [Medical website design](https://spectecle.com/services/medical-website-design): websites for doctors, dentists, and clinics
- [The Loop client portal](https://spectecle.com/services/the-loop): where clients submit and track requests
